This page will explore the relationship between runtime and ratings for well-known box office films. Based on the scatterplot @fig-runtime-rating, we can see that there is a weak correlation between longer runtime and higher ratings. 

::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDB Rating (0 to 10)")
plt.title("Runtime vs Rating")
plt.show()
```

films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
